title: Cuff leak on PSV: auto-triggering and prolonged breaths
summary: An orifice leak at the Y-piece (≈ 8 L/min at 20 cmH2O). The expiratory baseline flow offset looks like inspiratory demand, so the ventilator auto-triggers; during insufflation the leak keeps flow above the cycle-off threshold.
objectives: Spot the leak: Vte < Vti, volume not returning to baseline, loops that do not close.
Fix the leak (cuff) and watch triggering normalize; note that leak compensation alone is not enough here.
